name: Google Drive for desktop

version_check.notes: Google Keystone updater (proprietary). NO public version API. To detect version, download DMG and read Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString.

notes: Uses Google Keystone updater (same framework as Chrome). Auto-updates silently in the background. No public version API exists. Version only available by inspecting the installed DMG's Info.plist. macOS 13 or later. Disabled 2026-10-05: the download URL carries no version and Google publishes none (the release-notes page is JS-rendered), so the check can only fail. Re-enable if a versioned endpoint appears.
